title: 第八章 博九，大神又如何？
slug: 国民校草是女生全本免费-国民校草是女生最新章节列表
content_zh:
秦漠看着屏幕上的游戏人物，一开始还没有说话，等到看那人武器一转，万火纷飞时，眉头挑了一下：“去私戳他。“
喵系少年得了命令，眼睛都亮了，抱着手里的毛绒玩具，直接给黑桃K，也就是博九发过去了一个好友申请。
只是让他没有想到的是……对方居然拒绝加他为好友！
拒绝了？！
喵系少年岂止是受到了一千万的暴击！
要知道他的游戏名还在上面挂着呢，怎么会遭到拒绝？
在此不得不说一下，喵系少年本名COCO，游戏名也是这个，游戏操作能在国内排到前十！
这都不是重点，关键是他可是响当当的职业大神，每次开直播都能走出上百万的流量，这人居然拒绝加他为好友？
“我非要让他加上我不可！”COCO顶着一头的黄卷毛，迅速切换账号：“队长，你密码多少来着？”
秦漠也没有阻止他，薄唇微启的念出了一组数字。
COCO再次登入了游戏页面，刚一进主页，全服都给沸腾了！
“我看到什么了！是大神!妈蛋，真的是大神！”
“啊啊啊啊！求大神坐标！“
“好像隐了……“
COCO当然会把坐标隐掉。
用队长账号登游戏，那可是会造成网络瘫痪的！
又一次，他给博九发去了身份验证.
COCO抱着怀里的大白兔，很是洋洋得意，这一次他肯定跪下来喊哥！
哪里知道，竟然又是拒绝？
又是拒绝！！！

黑桃Z，你到底是闹哪样？！
COCO咬着兔子耳朵，愤怒了：“他是不是不认识字？但凡是玩游戏的人都知道秦少吧，全国联赛可是在电视网络上都进行过直播！“
秦漠伸手放下了手中的物理书，右手放在了键盘上，再一次的好友申请：“我是秦漠。“
博九原本还在测试自己手指的灵活度，却总是有人发好友申请过来，见对方契而不懈，博九叼着棒棒糖，空出手来懒洋洋的回了一句：“那又如何？“
仍然是拒绝的提示，只不过这一次多了一句话。
COCO看到那条消息之后，彻底傻眼了：“他，他什么意思？是知道秦少是谁，还拒绝！？”
秦漠狭长的凤眸眯了一下，此刻是真正的来了兴趣，嘴角也跟着向上扬了扬。
不会吧？秦少笑了？
一定是他看错了！
为了转移注意力，COCO一把将键盘夺了过来：“你知道还不通过？！”
没反应？
对方下线了？
下线了！！！
COCO就像是被什么东西撩到了，还没有解痒，撩人的家伙却不在了！
“秦少……”COCO转过头来，那样子就像是还没和人打，就已经输了的表情，好不委屈。
喜欢国民校草是女生请大家
content_en:
Qin Mo looked at the game character on the screen. He didn't speak at first. When he saw the man's weapon turning and fire flying, he raised his eyebrows and said, "Go and poke him privately."
After receiving the order, the cat boy's eyes lit up. He held the stuffed toy in his hand and sent a friend request directly to the King of Spades, that is, Bo Jiu.
But what he didn't expect was...the other party actually refused to add him as a friend!
Rejected? !
The meow-type boy received more than ten million critical hits!
Knowing that his game name is still hanging on it, how could he be rejected?
I have to say here that the real name of the meow boy is COCO, and the name of the game is also the same. The game operation can be ranked among the top ten in China!
This is not the point. The point is that he is a well-known professional master. Every time he starts a live broadcast, he can get millions of traffic. This person actually refuses to add him as a friend?
"I have to let him add me!" COCO, with his yellow curly hair on his head, quickly switched accounts: "Captain, what's your password?"
Qin Mo didn't stop him, and read out a set of numbers with his thin lips slightly parted.
COCO logged into the game page again. As soon as he entered the homepage, the whole server was excited!
"What did I see! It's a great god! Damn it, it's really a great god!"
"Ahhhh! Please give me the coordinates!"
"It seems to be hidden..."
Of course COCO will hide the coordinates.
Logging in to the game with a captain account will cause network paralysis!
Once again, he sent Bojiu to verify his identity.
COCO held the white rabbit in his arms and was very proud. This time he would definitely kneel down and call him brother!
How did you know that it was rejected again?
Another rejection! ! !
Z of Spades, what are you doing? !
COCO bit the rabbit's ear and became angry: "Does he not know how to read? Anyone who plays games knows Mr. Qin, right? The national leagues are broadcast live on TV networks!"
Qin Mo put down the physics book in his hand, put his right hand on the keyboard, and applied for friend again: "I am Qin Mo."
Bo Jiu was still testing the flexibility of his fingers, but there were always people sending friend requests over. Seeing that the relationship was unremitting, Bo Jiu held the lollipop in his mouth and replied lazily with his free hand: "So what?"
It’s still a reminder of rejection, but this time there’s an extra sentence.
After COCO saw the message, he was completely dumbfounded: "He, what does he mean? Does he know who Mr. Qin is and still refuse!?"
Qin Mo's narrow phoenix eyes narrowed, he was really interested at this moment, and the corners of his mouth also raised upwards.
No way? Mr. Qin smiled?
He must have seen it wrong!
In order to divert attention, COCO snatched the keyboard away: "You know it, but you still haven't passed it?!"
No response?
The other party is offline?
Offline! ! !
COCO seemed to be aroused by something. Before the itching could be relieved, the person who was teasing him was not there!
"Young Master Qin..." COCO turned around with an expression as if he had already lost before the fight, which made him feel aggrieved.
If you like the national school girl, please be a girl.
